description: Space Nebula is a team of young space enthusiasts combining science, creativity, and problem-solving to design innovative and realistic solutions for future space missions.
summary:
We created a game where everyеthing is interconnected, from the price of thruster to data which you get from the mission. We simplified the game to level where no formulas are presented to player, and everything is presented in intuitive terms of money, time, energy, electricity, radiation, mass, and data.  However, under the hood it uses real astrodynamics formulas astrodynamics formulas.

We worked on balance such that every decision of the player has its own сonsequences. For example, if player decided to save money on camera, player will get less money cause quality of data going to be poor.
details:
Our project is 2D game about space exploration. Player can build a rocket from parts which he/she can choose freely, make calculation on computer to find out how much energy, fuel and e.t.c rocket needs. Whereas, behind all of this, there are bunch of real formulas which provides realistic data on how much fuel, mass, energy and e.t.c rocket needs.
We simplified everything in a such way so everybody can play it and intuitively understand why he/she needs every component of the rocket. Moreover, when player fails the mission game gives reason why player failed it and explains in the Feynman way (like to the child). Also, it can be played right in the browser in whatever device you want.
When planing we where eager to make it accesible for everyone to understand how basics of astrodynamics and rocket building works. So we considered that our game will be persons who know nothing about physics
